name: Belial
source:
A demon king who has been handling grievances in her castle for a long time.

She is not good with swords or magic. She has not appeared in front of humans for hundreds of years, but one thing led to another and she was brought to the land of humans.

She struggles daily for herself and the demons.

[From [url=http://www.terra.dti.ne.jp/~f-rui/works/myworks/mahara_simai/sisters_top.html]official site[/url]]
